meta.title: Services: the Client Loop, and every piece of it on its own
meta.description: Our product is the Sansara Client Loop, a complete client acquisition system. Every piece of it is also available as a fixed-scope, fixed-price service.

hero.title: One product. And every piece of it, on its own.
hero.lead: Most clients want the whole path built. Some already have half of it and need one missing piece done properly. Both are fine. Everything here has a fixed scope and a fixed price.

product.label: Our product
product.title: The Sansara Client Loop
product.text: The complete client acquisition system: ad, page, follow-up and booking, connected into one path and handed over working. One offer, one fixed price, live in days, everything in your name.

list.label: Done-for-you services
list.lead: The building blocks the Loop is made of. Each one fits into the full system later, so nothing you buy now gets thrown away.

priceKinds.fixed: One fixed price, agreed in writing before we start.
priceKinds.from: A fixed price that depends on size. You get the exact figure in writing before we start.
priceKinds.monthly: A fixed monthly fee. Cancel any month; everything stays yours.
priceKinds.on-call: Quoted on a short call, because it depends on what you already have.

detail.partOfSystem: This is one of the pieces of the Sansara Client Loop. If you need the whole path, it is built as one connected job rather than pieces bought one at a time.

final.title: Not sure which piece you need?
final.text: That's what the free call is for. Thirty minutes looking at your business, and you leave knowing which piece is missing, with us or without us.
